description: Which free API tiers serve an LLM model, with the published free-tier rate limits (RPM, RPD, TPM, TPD, requests/month), context window and tool calling. Same rows and ranking (most requests per day first) as the free LLM API picker. Search by model or provider name, optionally by family.

noCard.description: true = only offers that never ask for a card

query.description: Model or provider name, e.g. "gpt-oss 120b", "gemini 2.5 flash", "groq"; every word must match

toolCalling.description: true = only models documented with tool calling

name: find_models
title: Find free LLM models and their rate limits
